title: Playboy: Karaoke Collection Volume 2
native_title: プレイボーイ・カラオケ ＶＯＬ２
overview:
The second volume of Playboy Karaoke Collection turns the Saturn into an adult karaoke machine. Pick a song and sing along while music videos featuring Playboy models play in the background.

A Japanese release for mature audiences only.
